title: overlay AND combine by SHAPE and SYMBOL and COLOR.

do_not_reinvent.shape: /data/parallelograms-next.json + /data/one-sphere-tesseract.json — shapes already nested/folded. combine by them. do not mint a new 4-sider.
do_not_reinvent.color: /data/prim-ryb.json + /data/globes-pearl-star.json — color already sat. mix middle. pearl. not a 4th prim.

by.shape: the form. oval · parallelogram · voxel. how it sits.
by.symbol: the mark. the name. the glyph. not a new alphabet.
by.color: the look. prims + mix. not a costume hose.

and: overlay AND combine. both. not pick. three keys. no 4th.

not.fourth: not size. not a new channel. remainder is not a 4th key.
not.paint: do not shader a combiner tonight. still no on the glass.

law: overlay + combine by shape · symbol · color. three. if a 4th key shows we filled p. if we combine by name only we left the look.
pull: use the three. overlay and combine. no new alphabet. no 4th key.
